scope: Retained Catalog bookmark tree, SSH and seven protocol bookmark editors through owned Client models; partial M4, no whole cutover

whole.qualification: This full run started before the owner changed the testing cadence; further intermediate work uses focused checks, with a full run after all engineering implementation.

sourceFreeMacPackage.qualification: Three actual package UI journeys, their three Web controls and three independent SDK consumers; not nine package-only cases.

behaviors: Retained virtualized tree, search, sorting, keyboard/context actions and owned expansion-only browser preferences
Actual Web and package create/edit SSH plus FTP/Telnet/serial/RDP/VNC/SPICE/Web bookmarks; startup directory and quick-command editing preserve saved authentication references
Actual grouping, atomic group-and-protocol update, shared-reference-safe SSH/Web duplication and deletion, group deletion retaining its children
Web first group response is discarded after server commit; dialog retries the same business key and payload with a fresh transport rpcId; only one group persists
Vault admission lost ACK uses readonly outcome without another secret write; Catalog lost ACK retains the same key/input; old generation admissions do not delete possibly referenced entries
Definite save failure retains newly created Vault entries because another window/Profile may already reference them; no automatic credential deletion

Shutdown joins owned work; actual package/Web databases contain four hosts and eleven bookmarks, no plaintext canaries, with nine encrypted Vault entries and four independently decryptable SSH references
Public Radix DialogContent preserves feature-owned DOM with asChild, including optional built-in close controls; no additional application React root
limitations: Remaining Files/Transfers/remote-desktop/Web session/automation/widgets/sync/advanced settings UI is still open; FTP/RDP/VNC/SPICE/Web bookmark launch integration is not accepted by this editor evidence
Further M5 behavior acceptance, data-copy/recovery, legacy removal, manual visual acceptance and default whole cutover remain open
Production home untouched; macOS unsigned engineering artifact only; no Windows/Linux native acceptance or formal publication inferred
